Apple Greene (Apple Greene Park) — 8720, 8740, 8760, 8840, 8860 and 8880 No. 1 Road

Strata plan NWS518 (recorded on a unit's property record for 8720 No. 1 Road). A low-rise wood-frame complex of several buildings at No. 1 Road and Francis Road, across from Seafair Shopping Centre. Current listings describe freehold strata ownership, frame-wood construction, and amenities including a clubhouse, indoor and outdoor pools, hot tub, sauna, exercise centre, guest suite, library and recreation facilities, with heat, hot water and city utilities included in strata fees at some addresses.

items.t: The anchor: Hugh Boyd Community Park, 9200 No. 1 Road, at No. 1 Road and Francis Road on Lulu Island — a City community park with the West Richmond Community Centre on site; the City lists its recreation area as West Richmond. Hugh Boyd Secondary School sits at the same 9200 No. 1 Road address.

Working anchors (no official neighbourhood boundary exists): the park at No. 1 Road and Francis Road, Blundell Road to the south (R.M. Grauer Elementary, 4440 Blundell Road), Granville Avenue to the north, and the Seafair planning area (planning area 6 on the City OCP Key Map) around it. Nearby: Terra Nova / Thompson to the north, Steveston North to the south across Williams Road, Blundell / Broadmoor to the east.

Where the condo stock concentrates: exactly one place — the south side of Francis Road at No. 1 Road, where the Apple Greene low-rise complex (8720–8880 No. 1 Road) stands across from Seafair Shopping Centre and a short walk south of the park.

The park itself: a pitch and putt course, artificial turf fields, turf sports fields, basketball courts, tennis courts, a playground and paved walking paths; West Richmond Community Centre on the same site has a fitness centre, gymnasium, squash court and badminton courts. The West Dyke Trail runs along the western dike west of the area, from Terra Nova Rural Park to Garry Point Park.

Transit: TransLink route 401 (One Road) runs on No. 1 Road through the area between Richmond–Brighouse Station (Canada Line) and Steveston Exchange, stopping beside Hugh Boyd Park and Hugh Boyd Secondary School; no SkyTrain station sits in the area. Main roads: No. 1 Road, Francis Road, Blundell Road, Granville Avenue.

Library and health: the nearest Richmond Public Library branches are the Steveston Branch (Easthope Hub) at 4320 Moncton Street and the Brighouse (Main) Branch at 100-7700 Minoru Gate; the nearest hospital is Richmond Hospital, 7000 Westminster Highway.

blocks.text: Good to know about Boyd Park

items.t: Official City sources show detached housing around the park and no named condo building. The MLS® sub-area label "Boyd Park" on listings at 8720–8880 No. 1 Road is what ties Apple Greene to this page; City planning material alone does not assign the complex to this name.

One complex, six addresses, two build years. Apple Greene's buildings run 8720 through 8880 No. 1 Road under one strata plan (NWS518), with directory and listing years split between 1973 and 1975 by address — document orders, depreciation reports and levy history run to the corporation and the specific building, not to a single "Apple Greene" date.

The amenity set is a 1970s resort package that still drives the fees. Indoor and outdoor pools, hot tub, sauna, gym, clubhouse, guest suite and library in a low-rise wood-frame complex means the depreciation report — now mandatory every five years — carries pool, envelope and parkade-free building systems that newer low-rises do not have.

The park across the street is a full community campus. Hugh Boyd Community Park holds the pitch and putt, turf fields, courts and playground, West Richmond Community Centre is on the same site, and Hugh Boyd Secondary School shares the 9200 No. 1 Road address — the complex's "across from the park" position comes with sports lighting, tournament traffic and school-day activity as the other side of the same fact.

The name on the park is Richmond's first warden. Hugh Boyd was the first Warden of the Corporation of the Township of Richmond, and the first council meetings were held in the dining room of his house on Sea Island after the Township was incorporated; the secondary school and the park carry his name.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Boyd Park

items.t: Form B diligence (Apple Greene — the pocket's one strata complex, apartment-form): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. The directory pet/rental lines in are directory data, not bylaws — the Form B and registered bylaws govern. The same diligence frame is what any future townhouse-strata purchase here would use; there is no townhouse strata for it to attach to today.

Depreciation reports / CRF minimum: since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, not deferrable by vote — Apple Greene (NWS518, a multi-building 1973–1975 complex) is well over the threshold on either published unit figure. Since Nov 1, 2023, at least 10% of the annual operating budget must go to the contingency reserve fund. In a complex of this age, the depreciation report and the capital-project record are the central diligence items.
Fee-simple homes (the pocket's detached stock): There is no verified fee-simple townhouse complex in the pocket; the fee-simple product here is detached houses with suite potential (below).

: Richmond Zoning Bylaw 8500, Official Community Plan Bylaw 9000 (the City of Richmond 2041 OCP, covering the area with Schedule 2 area and sub-area plans; no Boyd Park plan exists in that structure — the surrounding ground is planned as Seafair / West Richmond), Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw 8204. Houses around the park sit in Single Detached zones RS1 and RS2 (Section 8.1), with minimum lot areas by subzone including RS1/B 360.0 m², RS1/E 550.0 m², RS1/F 828.0 m² and RS1/K 315.0 m² and a 24.0 m minimum depth in most subzones; Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing zones RSM/S, RSM/M, RSM/L and RSM/XL also apply in the bylaw as amended. The zone and dimensions of a specific lot are confirmed parcel by parcel.

Richmond property tax timing: City of Richmond property taxes are due once a year on the first business day of July — Thursday, July 2, 2026 — with a 5% penalty on any unpaid balance after that date and a further 5% penalty on balances still outstanding after September 1, 2026.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Boyd Park

items.t: OCP — City of Richmond 2041 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 9000: covers the area, with Schedule 2 area and sub-area plans addressing neighbourhood issues; no Boyd Park plan exists in that structure — the surrounding ground is planned as Seafair / West Richmond.

Zoning — Richmond Zoning Bylaw 8500: houses around the park sit in Single Detached zones RS1 and RS2 (Section 8.1; subzone minimums), with RSM/S, RSM/M, RSM/L and RSM/XL Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing zones in the bylaw as amended. Confirm the parcel's zone and subzone before pricing any split.

Flood / dike diligence — Bylaw 8204: flood construction levels and dike setbacks under the Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw 8204 apply to new construction; the area sits in the Fraser River floodplain behind the 1:500-design system with dike raising under way. Get the parcel-level position before pricing a rebuild.

Aircraft noise: aircraft noise policy for Richmond is set out in City Bulletin DEVAPPS-05 and the Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy Area; a street-by-street noise contour finding for the Boyd Park area: Not verified.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Boyd Park ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.
